title: Yearn Vaults v3.1.0
protocolOverview: Yearn V3 Vaults is an ERC-4626 compliant vault system for accepting ERC-20 deposits, issuing yield-bearing shares, and allocating funds across external strategies. The vault acts as a flexible accounting and allocation layer, tracking strategy debt, reported gains and losses, profit unlocking, and user withdrawals.
auditScope: This audit covers the changes introduced by PR #235 across one day of review.
overallAssessment: Changes are minimal, the audit didn't identify any issues.

issues.title: TECH_SPEC incorrectly states withdrawals cannot be paused
issues.body:
`TECH_SPEC.md` states that withdrawals cannot be paused, but the updated `VaultV3.vy` implementation blocks withdrawals and redemptions when `paused` is set.

#### Technical Details

The emergency operation section of `TECH_SPEC.md` says `Withdrawals can't be paused under any circumstance`. The contract now exposes `setPaused()` and `isPaused()`, and the pause state affects both deposit and withdrawal flows. The specification therefore describes older behavior and no longer matches the contract.

#### Impact

Informational.

#### Recommendation

Update `TECH_SPEC.md` to describe the new pause semantics.

#### Developer Response

Fixed.
